title: Payment-Method Schedule for Eligibility-Transition Waivers
content:
**Schedule.** Under the payment-method schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a family whose Pre-K tuition account shows tuition payments by personal check or money order in the school year has an amount added to the eligibility-transition waiver of a late fee:

| Tuition payments by personal check or money order on the enrollment in the school year | Added to the waiver |
|---|---|
| two or more | 7.50 |
| exactly one | 5.00 |
| none | nothing |

Personal checks and money orders are counted together; online card and ACH bank draft payments are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

- One personal check and one money order: two counted, 7.50 added.
- A single money order among several card payments: 5.00 added.
- No paper payment: nothing added.
